primary_metric: within-block partial Spearman IC pIC(past_dxy_5, fwd_GC_5 | past_GC_5), 90% session-block bootstrap CI
result_summary: REJECTED (KT2 symmetry fired decisively). Forward pIC(past_dxy,fwd_GC|past_GC) = -0.0049 [-0.0078,-0.0020] correctly signed and significant, KT1 does NOT fire - but the REVERSE pIC is -0.0115, i.e. 2.36x LARGER (ES 1.37x, NQ 2.72x). Gold appears to lead the dollar more than the reverse = shared/non-synchronous contemporaneous information, not transmission. KT3 does NOT fire: EUR-only basket (0.42% stale vs 4.70%) retains the whole effect, so it is NOT a stale-price artifact - the measurement is sound, the interpretation fails. Mechanism's own differential prediction also fails (ES -0.0043 ~ GC -0.0049 despite ES being far more liquid). Economically -0.27 ticks vs ~$20 round trip; contemporaneous link is ~75x the 5-min lagged one. Also produced the 5-min shared-endpoint magnitudes: 31-56% of measured reversion is bid-ask-bounce artifact, worst (56%) on the synthetic dollar.

hypothesis: Gold under-reacts overnight to dollar moves because its overnight book is thin; the shortfall is completed once NY liquidity arrives
kill_test: KT1 primary IC CI includes 0 or the sign is negative; KT2 the unconstrained (on_GC, on_dxy) pair lacks the mechanism sign pattern; KT3 the effect is as strong on ES
data_scope: NQ+ES+GC 1-min RTH 09:30-16:00 ET 2011-08-01..2026-07-15, 3710 sessions; synthetic 4-leg DXY from CME 6E/6J/6B/6C; one row per session (3707)
primary_metric: Spearman IC(short_GC, rth_GC) with 90% session bootstrap CI; sign declared POSITIVE in advance
result_summary: REJECTED - all three kill tests fired, the cleanest rejection of the four. KT1: IC(short_GC,rth_GC) = -0.0301 [-0.0570,+0.0000], CI touches zero AND the sign is negative (declared in advance as a rejection). KT2: unconstrained rth ~ b1*on_GC + b2*on_dxy gives b1 +0.0261 / b2 -0.0338, both wrong-signed, both CIs spanning 0, R2 0.0017. KT3: -0.0301 GC / -0.0302 ES / -0.0239 NQ, indistinguishable, but the liquidity mechanism requires ES to be much weaker. Root cause and the generalisable lesson: the dollar explains only R2 0.127 of gold's overnight gap, so the shortfall degenerates into the negative of the raw gap (ICs print -0.0301 and +0.0301) - A FACTOR DECOMPOSITION IS ONLY INFORMATIVE WHERE THE FACTOR'S R2 IS LARGE. Horizon-matched overnight beta (-0.968 vs -0.902) checked and clears the pre-declared objection. Descriptive residue (sign-reversed from the hypothesis): gold's idiosyncratic overnight move CONTINUES into the first RTH hour and is spent by mid-session.

hypothesis: Follow-up on EXP-0003's one live cell: is gold's coherence momentum contrast simply the VOLATILITY confound (KT2) in a double-sorted form?
kill_test: the contrast collapses toward zero once the top/bottom coherence split is made WITHIN volatility quintiles as well as within slots
primary_metric: within-(slot x volatility-quintile) momentum contrast on cohz at matched 30% rate, 90% session-block CI, plus a 100-draw rule-18 re-pairing null
result_summary: KILL TEST FIRED - EXP-0003's gold screen was the VOLATILITY confound. Gold's contrast collapses +0.0496 [+0.0069,+0.0853] -> -0.0047 [-0.0274,+0.0272] once the top/bottom coherence split is made within VOLATILITY QUINTILES as well as within slots; the mirror arm (volatility given coherence) is +0.0020, also zero. 100-draw re-pairing null centres at 0 on all three markets and gold's frac>=real goes 0.067 -> 0.600. The collapse is NOT a weakened split: coherence spread between cells is unchanged (0.451/0.093 -> 0.439/0.095) while the volatility ratio falls 1.46 -> 1.11. METHOD CLAIM (the run's real output): matching a regime split on TIME OF DAY is not sufficient - EXP-0003 matched slot composition EXACTLY (identical cell sizes and slot mixes) and it still was not enough, because almost every intraday label is correlated with volatility. Sub-lesson from the selection side of vei_exploration finding P: a modest pairwise correlation between two labels does NOT imply the cells they select are matched. Economically the three markets point three ways (GC high-coherence t2.61, NQ LOW-coherence t3.59 = opposite, ES flat) and gold's surviving cell is +0.238 ticks = $2.38 vs a ~$20 round trip.
